newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT - Osem said to underperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Osem said to underperform.

text.p: Israel's Osem Investments Ltd will underperform the Tel Aviv share market due to a modest growth outlook and a relatively high share price valuation, Salomon Brothers analyst Victor Halpert said on Tuesday.

Halpert said Osem, Israel's second-largest food company, was trading at 18.5 times 1996 prospective earnings, compared with an average of 12 for companies traded in the Mishtanim index of the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange.

"On a (price-to-earnings) basis, Osem is trading at discounts to its international peers of 10.6 percent for 1996 and 8.7 percent for 1997," he said. "Most such companies are expected to enjoy stronger earnings growth than Osem in 1996-97".

Although the company's net earnings rose 1.62 percent year on year in the third-quarter, Halpert noted that domestic sales of Osem's brandname products had stagnated and that all third-quarter sales growth came from the introduction of new Nestle products.
Nestle has a strategic partnership with Osem and holds approximately 40 percent of the Israeli company.
